description: What the one window Hearth opens is allowed to ask the shell for: the three commands in src/main.rs, and nothing else. No plugin permission is granted, so the page cannot open a dialog, read a file, run a process, create a second window or read the clipboard, even though tauri-plugin-dialog is compiled in and used by the shell itself from inside those three commands, where the shell decides what the dialog says. The three names below are generated by tauri-build from the command list in build.rs, so a command that exists in main.rs and is not named here is not reachable. They are not a formality: the page is served over http on loopback rather than from Tauri's own protocol, which makes it a REMOTE origin as far as the access-control list is concerned, and a remote origin reaches nothing that is not spelled out. With this list left empty, handshake() was refused and the application could not start. Measured, not assumed.
